monetization_evidence.evidence: The company calls itself 'a global travel marketing partner that unites a world-class network of creators, an engaged travel community, and an AI-powered production workflow'. It says it started 'in 2012 as a passion project on Instagram'. Clients listed: Turkish Airlines, Brand USA, Saudi Tourism Authority, Accor, Visit Panama, Red Sea Global. Offices: London, New York, Dubai, Riyadh, Singapore.

The What We Do page sells distribution to a 'built-in audience' of 'over 50 million engaged travellers across our channels', described as organic rather than bought media. It targets travelers 'actively planning their next trip' during 'peak booking periods'. The Instagram account is therefore part of the paid inventory the agency sells. Individual paid posts were not verified.

Accor case study: 'creating over 1,000 assets across 50 hotels in the Middle East Africa Asia-Pacific (MEA APAC)'. Metrics shown: '40% Reduced Content Expenses', '10x Increased Content testing', '60 to 14 days Content Delivery Time reduction'. Channels are not specified.
BD Academy trains creators in 12-week cohorts in Dubai, 'powered by Dubai', which points to a tourism-board partnership model. No fee was shown.

content_mode_evidence: The bio says content comes 'from our network of world-class creators', and the captions credit named creators (@gmarcod91, @giorgioteti, @louiscannell, @emmanuellelarchet). The company describes 'authentic, on-location content'. It also mentions 'an AI-powered production workflow', but no AI-generated visuals were identified in the sample. None of these reels was frame-coded in the repo.
niche_focus: Global travel inspiration (destinations, luxury villas, overwater resorts, Amalfi, Maldives, Caribbean) from a creator network. The flagship channel of a B2B travel and tourism marketing agency.
cta_pattern: Creator-credit captions with aspirational framing ('foreshadowing what your trip ... will look like', 'Dreaming of ...', 'I think we just found the coolest villa ...') and question prompts for comments ('You've just won the lottery…. What's the first place you're travelling to? ✈️', 'Is this county on your bucket list yet?'). Credits and location use 📽️ @creator 📍Place. No booking or affiliate link in the captions. The bio link points to YouTube, and B2B contact is brands@beautifuldestinations.com.
